tagline: Italy's leading passive telecom infrastructure operator with long-term contracted revenues from major telecom operators
hero_kpi_rationale: TIM SpA revenue represents 87% of total revenues of €960M, constituting the primary performance driver and exposing the company to major customer concentration risk.

kpis.name: Revenue generated by TIM SpA
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenues derived from the primary contract with telecom operator TIM.
kpis.description: In 2023, €831M in revenues came from TIM SpA, representing 87% of total €960M.
kpis.signal: 87% of total revenues: major customer dependency

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated annual revenues of the company.
kpis.description: Total revenue of €960M in 2023, primarily from service agreements with TIM and Vodafone Italia.
kpis.signal: Stable through recurring contracts with operators

kpis.name: Goodwill
kpis.explanation: Intangible asset representing acquisition value in excess of net assets.
kpis.description: Goodwill amounts to €6,154M, or 66% of total assets, highlighting strong dependence on market valuation for impairment testing.
kpis.signal: Goodwill represents 142% of equity: high impairment risk

kpis.name: Right-of-Use Assets
kpis.explanation: Value of leased assets recognized on balance sheet under IFRS 16.
kpis.description: Total amount of rights-of-use for third-party assets (e.g., land, buildings) recognized on balance sheet: €1,149M.
kpis.signal: High right-of-use assets: significant real estate leasing intensity

kpis.name: Lease Liabilities
kpis.explanation: Liabilities associated with future discounted lease payments under IFRS 16.
kpis.description: Financial liabilities related to leases amount to €982M, reflecting the significance of long-term lease commitments.
kpis.signal: Significant lease liability: impact on balance sheet structure

kpis.name: Annual Depreciation
kpis.explanation: Annual charge related to wear and tear of right-of-use assets.
kpis.description: Annual depreciation of right-of-use assets: €185M, recorded in income statement.

kpis.name: Interest Expenses
kpis.explanation: Annual interest cost on lease liabilities.
kpis.description: Interest charges related to lease liabilities: €27M in 2023.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €9.6B in latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, technological innovation, or AI solutions in provided documents. The company focuses on passive telecom infrastructure.
evidence: No AI reference in audit report
Absence of R&D or technological innovation mentioned
Activity centered on tower management and service contracts
